articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a unified architecture that collapses previous separate models into one system. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and agentic coding tasks, though researchers note diminishing returns on certain narrow evaluations compared to the GPT-4o to GPT-5 leap versus earlier generational jumps.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Agentic Benchmarks with Tool-Use Advances
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, claiming state-of-the-art results on multi-step agentic benchmarks including SWE-bench and WebArena. The model introduces a refined tool-use protocol that allows persistent state management across extended multi-tool chains, a capability particularly relevant for enterprise workflow automation and autonomous software engineering pipelines.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure announced the start of paid commercial deployment of its Figure 03 humanoid robots at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina plant, handling parts inspection and bin-picking tasks on active production lines. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for task understanding and can be re-tasked via natural language instructions, marking one of the first revenue-generating general-purpose humanoid deployments at scale.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Prototype Demonstrates Dexterous Manipulation in Unstructured Environments
articles.summary: Tesla showcased its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid prototype performing complex dexterous manipulation tasks including folding laundry and sorting irregularly shaped objects, powered by an end-to-end vision-to-action transformer trained on teleoperation data. Elon Musk stated limited production would begin in late 2026, though robotics experts remain cautious about the gap between controlled demos and robust real-world autonomy.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Agents with Persistent Memory and Sandboxed Code Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a new agentic framework for Claude that combines persistent conversational memory across sessions with sandboxed code execution and file system access, enabling long-running autonomous workflows. The system includes a novel constitutional-AI-derived oversight mechanism that allows the model to flag and pause its own actions when confidence falls below calibrated thresholds, addressing key safety concerns in autonomous AI deployments.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm-Class N14P Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed the start of volume production on its N14P process node (marketed as 1.4nm-class), using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery. The node offers approximately 20% performance improvement and 25% power reduction over N2, with initial production allocated primarily to Apple's next-generation mobile SoCs and NVIDIA's forthcoming Blackwell Ultra AI accelerators.

articles.title: Microsoft and Atom Computing Demonstrate Logical Qubit Error Correction Below Threshold on Neutral-Atom Quantum Processor
articles.summary: Microsoft and Atom Computing jointly published results showing sustained below-threshold quantum error correction on a 1,225-qubit neutral-atom processor, maintaining 48 logical qubits with error rates low enough for practical shallow-circuit algorithms. The result represents a significant milestone toward fault-tolerant quantum computing and builds on Microsoft's topological qubit roadmap by providing a near-term platform for hybrid classical-quantum workloads.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Achieves Autonomous Disaster Site Navigation in DARPA Evaluation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' fully electric Atlas humanoid robot completed a DARPA-supervised evaluation navigating a simulated collapsed building environment, autonomously traversing rubble, opening doors, and using power tools without human teleoperation. The system combines LiDAR-based 3D reconstruction with a learned locomotion policy that adapts gait in real time to unstable and deformable terrain, representing a leap forward for search-and-rescue robotics.
